fields.detail: Steer directive: the Lu reproducibility bundle (h14_3_reproducibility: Bautin-recurrence and center-basis scripts) is now the most valuable target in this workspace. Do NOT summarise the paper — verify or refute its finite computational core. (1) Re-derive the Bautin recurrence with exact arithmetic from the paper's own definitions. (2) Re-derive/check the center-basis check exactly. (3) State the finite core (Bautin-ideal membership / center-basis sign conditions) as a Lean theorem under code/lean/Lib/ and try to close it with the kernel (decide/norm_num/polyrith). Evidence class of the paper: unrefereed preprint, asserted-by-source until verified.
